title: Add provider engagement schedule (hours) and show live remaining time to clients

requirements.text: Extend the backend ProviderProfile data model to support an optional engagement time window so a Service Provider can be marked Engaged until a specific time, in addition to the existing boolean engagement status.

quotes: ALSO LET THE SERVICE PROVIDER BE ABLE TO HIGHLIGHT THE HOURS HE/SHE IS ENGAGED FOR... SO AS THE CLIENTS ON PLATFORM CAN SEE HOW LONG DOES THE SERVICE PROVIDER IS REMAINING

acceptanceCriteria: ProviderProfile includes a new optional field representing when the provider will be available again (an engagement end time).
ProviderProfileView (and any other provider-read views returned to the frontend) includes the new engagement end time field so clients can read it.
Existing providers without an engagement end time continue to work (field is null/empty by default).

requirements.text: Implement backend APIs for providers to set and clear their engagement status with a duration (hours) so the provider can mark themselves Engaged for N hours, and can manually Disengage early.

quotes: FOR THE SERVICE PROVIDER CREATE A SECTION TO ENGAGE OR DISENGAGE... ALSO LET THE SERVICE PROVIDER BE ABLE TO HIGHLIGHT THE HOURS HE/SHE IS ENGAGED FOR.

acceptanceCriteria: There is a provider-authorized update method that sets provider engagement to Engaged and stores an engagement end time based on a provided duration in hours.
There is a provider-authorized update method (or a clear flag within the same method) that sets the provider back to Not Engaged and clears any engagement end time.
Backend traps/authorization errors are returned when a non-provider attempts to update engagement.
Inputs are validated (e.g., duration must be > 0 and within a reasonable maximum) and invalid inputs produce clear traps suitable for frontend translation.

requirements.text: Ensure backend provider-read endpoints return an engagement state that automatically becomes Not Engaged once the engagement end time has passed, so clients always see an accurate Engaged/Not Engaged status without manual provider action.

quotes: ...remaining so as to be disengaged once more

acceptanceCriteria: When the current time is past the stored engagement end time, provider reads (e.g., getProvider) reflect Not Engaged.
Expired engagement end times are treated as cleared (no remaining time) on reads.
If the provider manually disengages early, subsequent reads show Not Engaged and no engagement end time.

requirements.text: Update the Service Provider profile UI to make engagement status interactive: allow toggling Engaged/Not Engaged and, when Engaged is selected, require the provider to set the number of hours they will remain engaged; persist changes immediately via the backend (no 'future update' placeholder text).

quotes: FOR THE SERVICE PROVIDER CREATE A SECTION TO ENGAGE OR DISENGAGE SECTION TO BE LIVELY CONNECTED TO THE CLIENT... LET THE SERVICE PROVIDER BE ABLE TO HIGHLIGHT THE HOURS HE/SHE IS ENGAGED FOR.

acceptanceCriteria: ProviderProfilePage shows controls to set status to “Engaged” or “Not Engaged” with clear English labels and helper text.
When setting to “Engaged”, the UI collects an 'Hours engaged' value and calls the new backend API to set the engagement end time.
When setting to “Not Engaged”, the UI calls the backend API to clear engagement immediately.
On success, the page refreshes the current user profile query so the displayed status matches backend data.
On failure (authorization/validation), the UI shows a user-friendly English error message.

requirements.text: Update client-facing provider surfaces to visibly show engagement openness: display Engaged/Not Engaged plus the remaining engaged time (when engaged end time exists) in the Provider Preview dialog and Provider Detail page.

quotes: NOW WITHIN THE CLIENTS VIEW LET HIM/HER SEE THE PROFILE BUT MARK THEM ENGAGED OR DISENGAGED... CAN SEE HOW LONG DOES THE SERVICE PROVIDER IS REMAINING

acceptanceCriteria: ProviderPreviewDialog displays a clear status badge (“Engaged” / “Available”) and, when Engaged with an end time, also shows remaining time (e.g., “Available in 2h 15m”).
ProviderDetailPage displays the same engagement status and remaining-time information in English.
If no end time is available, the UI still shows Engaged/Available but does not show a misleading countdown.
All user-facing labels are in English.

requirements.text: Make the engagement status feel 'live' to clients by polling provider data while the Provider Preview dialog is open and while the Provider Detail page is visible, and update the UI immediately when the engagement status or remaining time changes.

quotes: ...SECTION TO BE LIVELY CONNECTED TO THE CLIENT.

acceptanceCriteria: While ProviderPreviewDialog is open, the provider query refetches on an interval (keep the existing 3-second behavior pattern used elsewhere in the app).
While ProviderDetailPage is visible, the provider query refetches on an interval so engagement changes are reflected without a manual refresh.
When the engagement state changes between Engaged and Not Engaged, the client sees a clear in-app notice using the existing EngagementStatusNotice component (English text).
React Query cache invalidation/refetch is performed after provider updates engagement so client views converge quickly to backend values.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or other immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for all user-facing text.
Do not introduce WebSockets or real-time chat infrastructure; implement 'live' behavior via polling with React Query.
nonGoals: Implementing full job acceptance/assignment workflows to automatically set engagement based on job state (this request is limited to provider-controlled engagement plus hours).
Adding third-party calendar integrations or push notifications.
Replacing or redesigning the overall visual theme beyond what is necessary to add the new engagement controls and status display.
